main_text.p: thobbaos dicebat: drachmam, argyrida: (ᾰ̓ ξονϐοrem βροπχέρλω: et præconem ἀπυτὴν.) choenica, hemerotrophida. Sic & Atticus Herodes lignum, quod inseritur rotis, trochopedam nuncupavit, quum per asclivia (declivia, κατάντες τόπος) vectaretur, aliis epochita vocantibus, Hæc ille ex Athenæi tertio Dipnosophistarum. Idem Alexarchus, ut refert Athenæus, ad Cassandrensium senato res epistolam dedit hujusmodi: Ἀλέξαρχος ὁ μάρμων. Πρόμοις (forte προμοῖς ad inscriptionem pertinet, ut epistola incipiat a verbo χαθεῖν) χαθεῖν τὰς ἡλιοχρεῖς οἰῶν, οἴδα λυπῆσαι θεῶν τῶν ἔργων κεχτίνοις μορσίμω τύχα κεκυρωμένας θεῦ πόγαις χυτλώσαντες αὐτὰς, μὴ φύλακας ὀρυγῖρεῖς. Quid vero hæc epistola sibi velit (inquit Athenæus) ne ipsum quidem Pythium dignoscere arbitror. Germanice etiam vocabula quædam confinguntur ingeniose, ut vilhelmis pro caufia straminea: vilringis pro thorace annulis concatenato.

Thebani, inquit idem Atheraeus lib. 14. no Thebanis vis & rarls præcipuè dictionibus gaudent. Sepiam vocant opisthotilan, medicum factân, pontem phlëphyran, ficus tyca hirundines χωτιλάδλας, ridere, ἐκχρεμίμω: τὼ σύθια σιν' ἀχελον.

page.notes: Greek passages are copied as far as legible; the scan is faint and several Greek words are uncertain (e.g. "ᾰ̓ ξονϐοrem", "κεχτίνοις", "θεῦ πόγαις", "ἐκχρεμίμω", "σύθια", "ἀχελον") and should be checked against the original; they are not marked with [?] because of the layout constraint. The margin note "Thebanis" is read from the italic marginal word at the right; its exact form is uncertain. Latin "ferrum" and other words in the text are copied as printed. The page number and running head are as printed.
